title: Juzz : 18
introduction:
SURAH AL-MU’MINUN (THE BELIEVERS)

SURAH AN-NUR (THE LIGHT)

SURAH AL-FURQAN (THE CRITERION)

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
قَدْ اَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَۙ‏(1)
verses.translation: (1) Successful indeed are the believers,

verses.arabic: الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ فِىْ صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُوْنَ ۙ‏(2)
verses.translation: (2) Who are humble in their prayers,

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُوْنَۙ‏(3)
verses.translation: (3) And who keep aloof from what is vain,

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ لِلزَّكٰوةِ فَاعِلُوْنَۙ‏(4)
verses.translation: (4) And who are givers of poor-rate,

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ لِفُرُوْجِهِمْ حٰفِظُوْنَۙ‏(5)
verses.translation: (5) And who guard their private parts,

verses.arabic: اِلَّا عَلٰٓى اَزْوَاجِهِمْ اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُوْمِيْنَ‌ۚ‏(6)
verses.translation: (6) Except before their mates or those whom their right hands possess, for they surely are not blameable,

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ابْتَغٰى وَرَآءَ ذٰ لِكَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْعٰدُوْنَ‌ ۚ‏(7)
verses.translation: (7) But whoever seeks to go beyond that, these are they that exceed the limits;

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ لِاَمٰنٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُوْنَ ۙ‏(8)
verses.translation: (8) And those who are keepers of their trusts and their covenant,

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ عَلٰى صَلَوٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُوْنَ‌ۘ‏(9)
verses.translation: (9) And those who keep a guard on their prayers;

verses.arabic: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْوَارِثُوْنَ ۙ‏(10)
verses.translation: (10) These are they who are the heirs,

verses.arabic: الَّذِيْنَ يَرِثُوْنَ الْفِرْدَوْسَؕ هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ‏(11)
verses.translation: (11) Who shall inherit the Paradise; they shall abide therein.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ طِيْنٍ‌ ۚ‏(12)
verses.translation: (12) And certainly We created man of an extract of clay,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِىْ قَرَارٍ مَّكِيْنٍ‏(13)
verses.translation: (13) Then We made him a small seed in a firm resting-place,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظٰمَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنٰهُ خَلْقًا اٰخَرَ‌ ؕ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ اَحْسَنُ الْخٰلِقِيْنَ ؕ‏(14)
verses.translation: (14) Then We made the seed a clot, then We made the clot a lump of flesh, then We made (in) the lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, then We caused it to grow into another creation, so blessed be Allah, the best of the creators.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُوْنَؕ‏(15)
verses.translation: (15) Then after that you will most surely die.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُوْنَ‏(16)
verses.translation: (16) Then surely on the day of resurrection you shall be raised.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ ۖ  وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غٰفِلِيْنَ‏(17)
verses.translation: (17) And certainly We made above you seven heavens; and never are We heedless of creation.

verses.arabic: وَاَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَاَسْكَنّٰهُ فِى الْاَرْضِ‌ۖ وَاِنَّا عَلٰى ذَهَابٍۢ بِهٖ لَقٰدِرُوْنَ‌ ۚ‏(18)
verses.translation: (18) And We send down water from the cloud according to a measure, then We cause it to settle in the earth, and most surely We are able to carry it away.

verses.arabic: فَاَنْشَاْنَا لَكُمْ بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ مِّنْ نَّخِيْلٍ وَّ اَعْنَابٍ‌ ۘ لَكُمْ فِيْهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيْرَةٌ وَّمِنْهَا تَاْكُلُوْنَ ۙ‏(19)
verses.translation: (19) Then We cause to grow thereby gardens of palm trees and grapes for you; you have in them many fruits and from them do you eat;

verses.arabic: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُوْرِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنْۢبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْاٰكِلِيْنَ‏(20)
verses.translation: (20) And a tree that grows out of Mount Sinai which produces oil and a condiment for those who eat.

verses.arabic: وَ اِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى الْاَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً‌   ؕ نُسْقِيْكُمْ مِّمَّا فِىْ بُطُوْنِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيْرَةٌ وَّمِنْهَا تَاْكُلُوْنَ ۙ‏(21)
verses.translation: (21) And most surely there is a lesson for you in the cattle: We make you to drink of what is in their bellies, and you have in them many advantages and of them you eat,

verses.arabic: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُوْنَ‏(22)
verses.translation: (22) And on them and on the ships you are borne.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖ فَقَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهٗ ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ‏(23)
verses.translation: (23) And certainly We sent Nuh to his people, and he said: O my people! serve Allah, you have no god other than Him; will you not then guard (against evil)?

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ الْمَلَؤُا الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهٖ مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۙ يُرِيْدُ اَنْ يَّتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ ؕ وَلَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَاَنْزَلَ مَلٰٓئِكَةً  ۖۚ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهٰذَا فِىْۤ اٰبَآئِنَا الْاَوَّلِيْنَ‌ ۚ‏(24)
verses.translation: (24) And the chiefs of those who disbelieved from among his people said: He is nothing but a mortal like yourselves who desires that he may have superiority over you, and if Allah had pleased, He could certainly have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our fathers of yore:

verses.arabic: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوْا بِهٖ حَتّٰى حِيْنٍ‏(25)
verses.translation: (25) He is only a madman, so bear with him for a time.

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِىْ بِمَا كَذَّبُوْنِ‏(26)
verses.translation: (26) He said: O my Lord! help me against their calling me a liar.

verses.arabic: فَاَوْحَيْنَاۤ اِلَيْهِ اَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِاَعْيُنِنَا وَ وَحْيِنَا فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّوْرُ‌ۙ فَاسْلُكْ فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَاَهْلَكَ اِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ‌ۚ وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِىْ فِى الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا‌ۚ اِنَّهُمْ مُّغْرَقُوْنَ‏(27)
verses.translation: (27) So We revealed to him, saying: Make the ark before Our eyes and (according to) Our revelation; and when Our command is given and the valley overflows, take into it of every kind a pair, two, and your followers, except those among them against whom the word has gone forth, and do not speak to Me in respect of those who are unjust; surely they shall be drowned.

verses.arabic: فَاِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ اَنْتَ وَمَنْ مَّعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ نَجّٰٮنَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ‏(28)
verses.translation: (28) And when you are firmly seated, you and those with you, in the ark, say: All praise is due to Allah who delivered us from the unjust people:

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ رَّبِّ اَنْزِلْنِىْ مُنْزَلًا مُّبٰرَكًا وَّاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِيْنَ‏(29)
verses.translation: (29) And say: O my Lord! cause me to disembark a blessed alighting, and Thou art the best to cause to alight.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰ لِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ وَّاِنْ كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِيْنَ‏(30)
verses.translation: (30) Most surely there are signs in this, and most surely We are ever trying (men).

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا اٰخَرِيْنَ‌ ۚ‏(31)
verses.translation: (31) Then We raised up after them another generation.

verses.arabic: فَاَرْسَلْنَا فِيْهِمْ رَسُوْلًا مِّنْهُمْ اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهٗ‌ ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ‏(32)
verses.translation: (32) So We sent among them an apostle from among them, saying: Serve Allah, you have no god other than Him; will you not then guard (against evil)?

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَكَذَّبُوْا بِلِقَآءِ الْاٰخِرَةِ وَاَتْرَفْنٰهُمْ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا ۙ مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۙ يَاْكُلُ مِمَّا تَاْكُلُوْنَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُوْنَ ۙ‏(33)
verses.translation: (33) And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and called the meeting of the hereafter a lie, and whom We had given plenty to enjoy in this world's life, said: This is nothing but a mortal like yourselves, eating of what you eat from and drinking of what you drink.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ اَطَعْتُمْ بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ اِنَّكُمْ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوْنَۙ‏(34)
verses.translation: (34) And if you obey a mortal like yourselves, then most surely you will be losers:

verses.arabic: اَيَعِدُكُمْ اَنَّكُمْ اِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنْتُمْ تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا اَنَّكُمْ مُّخْرَجُوْنَ ۙ‏(35)
verses.translation: (35) What! does he threaten you that when you are dead and become dust and bones that you shall then be brought forth?

verses.arabic: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ ۙ‏(36)
verses.translation: (36) Far, far is that which you are threatened with.

verses.arabic: اِنْ هِىَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوْتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوْثِيْنَ ۙ‏(37)
verses.translation: (37) There is naught but our life in this world; we die and we live and we shall not be raised again.

verses.arabic: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلُ ۟افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا وَّمَا نَحْنُ لَهٗ بِمُؤْمِنِيْنَ‏(38)
verses.translation: (38) He is naught but a man who has forged a lie against Allah, and we are not going to believe in him.

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِىْ بِمَا كَذَّبُوْنِ‏(39)
verses.translation: (39) He said: O my Lord! help me against their calling me a liar.

verses.arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيْلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نٰدِمِيْنَ‌ۚ‏(40)
verses.translation: (40) He said: In a little while they will most certainly be repenting.

verses.arabic: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنٰهُمْ غُثَآءً‌ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ‏(41)
verses.translation: (41) So the punishment overtook them in justice, and We made them as rubbish; so away with the unjust people.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُوْنًا اٰخَرِيْنَؕ‏(42)
verses.translation: (42) Then We raised after them other generations.

verses.arabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَاْخِرُوْنَؕ‏(43)
verses.translation: (43) No people can hasten on their doom nor can they postpone (it).

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ اَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا‌ ؕ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ اُمَّةً رَّسُوْلُهَا كَذَّبُوْهُ‌ فَاَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضًا وَّجَعَلْنٰهُمْ اَحَادِيْثَ‌ ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ‏(44)
verses.translation: (44) Then We sent Our apostles one after another; whenever there came to a people their apostle, they called him a liar, so We made some of them follow others and We made them stories; so away with a people who do not believe!

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى وَاَخَاهُ هٰرُوْنَ ۙ بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍۙ‏(45)
verses.translation: (45) Then We sent Musa and his brother Haroun, with Our communications and a clear authority,

verses.arabic: اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَاۡئِهٖ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوْا وَكَانُوْا قَوْمًا عٰلِيْنَ‌ ۚ‏(46)
verses.translation: (46) To Firon and his chiefs, but they behaved haughtily and they were an insolent people.

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوْۤا اَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عٰبِدُوْنَ‌ۚ‏(47)
verses.translation: (47) And they said: What! shall we believe in two mortals like ourselves while their people serve us?

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوْهُمَا فَكَانُوْا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِيْنَ‏(48)
verses.translation: (48) So they rejected them and became of those who were destroyed.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُوْنَ‏(49)
verses.translation: (49) And certainly We gave Musa the Book that they may follow a right direction.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَاُمَّهٗۤ اٰيَةً وَّاٰوَيْنٰهُمَاۤ اِلٰى رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَّمَعِيْنٍ‏(50)
verses.translation: (50) And We made the son of Marium and his mother a sign, and We gave them a shelter on a lofty ground having meadows and springs.

verses.arabic: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوْا مِنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَاعْمَلُوْا صَالِحًا‌ ؕ اِنِّىْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ عَلِيْمٌ ؕ‏(51)
verses.translation: (51) O apostles! eat of the good things and do good; surely I know what you do.

verses.arabic: وَاِنَّ هٰذِهٖۤ اُمَّتُكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّاَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُوْنِ‏(52)
verses.translation: (52) And surely this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, therefore be careful (of your duty) to Me.

verses.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوْۤا اَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا‌ ؕ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۢ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُوْنَ‏(53)
verses.translation: (53) But they cut off their religion among themselves into sects, each part rejoicing in that which is with them.

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ فِىْ غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتّٰى حِيْنٍ‏(54)
verses.translation: (54) Therefore leave them in their overwhelming ignorance till

verses.arabic: اَيَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهٖ مِنْ مَّالٍ وَّبَنِيْنَۙ‏(55)
verses.translation: (55) Do they think that by what We aid them with of wealth and children,

verses.arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى الْخَيْرٰتِ‌ ؕ بَلْ لَّا يَشْعُرُوْنَ‏(56)
verses.translation: (56) We are hastening to them of good things? Nay, they do not perceive.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّشْفِقُوْنَۙ‏(57)
verses.translation: (57) Surely they who from fear of their Lord are cautious,

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُوْنَۙ‏(58)
verses.translation: (58) And those who believe in the communications of their Lord,

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُوْنَۙ‏(59)
verses.translation: (59) And those who do not associate (aught) with their Lord,

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ يُؤْتُوْنَ مَاۤ اٰتَوْا وَّ قُلُوْبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ اَنَّهُمْ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمْ رٰجِعُوْنَ ۙ‏(60)
verses.translation: (60) And those who give what they give (in alms) while their hearts are full of fear that to their Lord they must return,

verses.arabic: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُسَارِعُوْنَ فِىْ الْخَيْرٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سٰبِقُوْنَ‏(61)
verses.translation: (61) These hasten to good things and they are foremost in (attaining) them.

verses.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَا‌ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتٰبٌ يَّنْطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ‌ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ‏(62)
verses.translation: (62) And We do not lay on any soul a burden except to the extent of its ability, and with Us is a book which speaks the truth, and they shall not be dealt with unjustly.

verses.arabic: بَلْ قُلُوْبُهُمْ فِىْ غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هٰذَا وَلَهُمْ اَعْمَالٌ مِّنْ دُوْنِ ذٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عٰمِلُوْنَ‏(63)
verses.translation: (63) Nay, their hearts are in overwhelming ignorance with respect to it and they have besides this other deeds which they do.

verses.arabic: حَتّٰۤى اِذَاۤ اَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيْهِمْ بِالْعَذَابِ اِذَا هُمْ يَجْئَرُوْنَؕ‏(64)
verses.translation: (64) Until when We overtake those who lead easy lives among them with punishment, lo! they cry for succor.

verses.arabic: لَا تَجْئَرُوا الْيَوْمَ‌ اِنَّكُمْ مِّنَّا لَا تُنْصَرُوْنَ‏(65)
verses.translation: (65) Cry not for succor this day; surely you shall not be given help from Us.

verses.arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ اٰيٰتِىْ تُتْلٰى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ عَلٰٓى اَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنْكِصُوْنَۙ‏(66)
verses.translation: (66) My communications were indeed recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels,

verses.arabic: مُسْتَكْبِرِيْنَ ‌ۖ  بِهٖ سٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُوْنَ‏(67)
verses.translation: (67) In arrogance; talking nonsense about the Quran, and left him like one telling fables by night.

verses.arabic: اَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا الْقَوْلَ اَمْ جَآءَهُمْ مَّا لَمْ يَاْتِ اٰبَآءَهُمُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ‏(68)
verses.translation: (68) Is it then that they do not ponder over what is said, or is it that there has come to them that which did not come to their fathers of old?

verses.arabic: اَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوْا رَسُوْلَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهٗ مُنْكِرُوْنَ‏(69)
verses.translation: (69) Or is it that they have not recognized their Apostle, so that they deny him?

verses.arabic: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ  ؕ بَلْ جَآءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَاَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كٰرِهُوْنَ‏(70)
verses.translation: (70) Or do they say: There is madness in him? Nay! he has brought them the truth, and most of them are averse from the truth.

verses.arabic: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالْاَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيْهِنَّ‌ؕ بَلْ اَتَيْنٰهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَؕ‏(71)
verses.translation: (71) And should the truth follow their low desires, surely the heavens and the earth and all those who are therein would have perished. Nay! We have brought to them their reminder, but from their reminder they turn aside.

verses.arabic: اَمْ تَسْئَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرٰجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ‌ ‌ۖ  وَّهُوَ خَيْرُ الرّٰزِقِيْنَ‏(72)
verses.translation: (72) Or is it that you ask them a recompense? But the recompense of your Lord is best, and He is the best of those who provide sustenance.

verses.arabic: وَاِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوْهُمْ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ‏(73)
verses.translation: (73) And most surely you invite them to a right way.

verses.arabic: وَاِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنٰكِبُوْنَ‏(74)
verses.translation: (74) And most surely those who do not believe in the hereafter are deviating from the way.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِّنْ ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوْا فِىْ طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُوْنَ‏(75)
verses.translation: (75) And if We show mercy to them and remove the distress they have, they would persist in their inordinacy, blindly wandering on.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اَخَذْنٰهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوْا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُوْنَ‏(76)
verses.translation: (76) And already We overtook them with chastisement, but they were not submissive to their Lord, nor do they humble themselves.

verses.arabic: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيْدٍ اِذَا هُمْ فِيْهِ مُبْلِسُوْنَ‏(77)
verses.translation: (77) Until when We open upon them a door of severe chastisement, lo! they are in despair at it.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِىْۤ اَنْشَاَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْئِدَةَ‌  ؕ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ‏(78)
verses.translation: (78) And He it is Who made for you the ears and the eyes and the hearts; little is it that you give thanks.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِىْ ذَرَاَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَاِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ‏(79)
verses.translation: (79) And He it is Who multiplied you in the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِىْ يُحْىٖ وَيُمِيْتُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلَافُ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ‏(80)
verses.translation: (80) And He it is Who gives life and causes death, and (in) His (control) is the alternation of the night and the day; do you not then understand?

verses.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوْا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ‏(81)
verses.translation: (81) Nay, they say the like of what the ancients said:

verses.arabic: قَالُوْۤا ءَاِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّ عِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبْعُوْثُوْنَ‏(82)
verses.translation: (82) They say: What! When we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we then be raised?

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَاٰبَآؤُنَا هٰذَا مِنْ قَبْلُ اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اَسَاطِيْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ‏(83)
verses.translation: (83) Certainly we are promised this, and (so were) our fathers aforetime; this is naught but stories of those of old.

verses.arabic: قُلْ لِّمَنِ الْاَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيْهَاۤ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(84)
verses.translation: (84) Say: Whose is the earth, and whoever is therein, if you know?

verses.arabic: سَيَقُوْلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ‌ؕ قُلْ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ‏(85)
verses.translation: (85) They will say: Allah's. Say: Will you not then mind?

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَنْ رَّبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ‏(86)
verses.translation: (86) Say: Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the mighty dominion?

verses.arabic: سَيَقُوْلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ‌ؕ قُلْ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ‏(87)
verses.translation: (87) They will say: (This is) Allah's. Say: Will you not then guard (against evil)?

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَنْۢ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَكُوْتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَّهُوَ يُجِيْرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(88)
verses.translation: (88) Say: Who is it in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things and Who gives succor, but against Him Succor is not given, if you do but know?

verses.arabic: سَيَقُوْلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ‌ؕ قُلْ فَاَنّٰى تُسْحَرُوْنَ‏(89)
verses.translation: (89) They will say: (This is) Allah's. Say: From whence are you then deceived?

verses.arabic: بَلْ اَتَيْنٰهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَاِنَّهُمْ لَكٰذِبُوْنَ‏(90)
verses.translation: (90) Nay! We have brought to them the truth, and most surely they are liars.

verses.arabic: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ وَّلَدٍ وَّمَا كَانَ مَعَهٗ مِنْ اِلٰهٍ‌ اِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ اِلٰهٍۢ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ‌ؕ سُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَۙ‏(91)
verses.translation: (91) Never did Allah take to Himself a son, and never was there with him any (other) god-- in that case would each god have certainly taken away what he created, and some of them would certainly have overpowered others; glory be to Allah above what they describe!

verses.arabic: عٰلِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ‏(92)
verses.translation: (92) The Knower of the unseen and the seen, so may He be exalted above what they associate (with Him).

verses.arabic: قُل رَّبِّ اِمَّا تُرِيَنِّىْ مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَۙ‏(93)
verses.translation: (93) Say: O my Lord! if Thou shouldst make me see what they are threatened with:

verses.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِىْ فِى الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ‏(94)
verses.translation: (94) My Lord! then place me not with the unjust.

verses.arabic: وَاِنَّا عَلٰٓى اَنْ نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقٰدِرُوْنَ‏(95)
verses.translation: (95) And most surely We are well able to make you see what We threaten them with.

verses.arabic: اِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِىْ هِىَ اَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ‌ ؕ نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُوْنَ‏(96)
verses.translation: (96) Repel evil by what is best; We know best what they describe.

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ رَّبِّ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزٰتِ الشَّيٰطِيْنِۙ‏(97)
verses.translation: (97) And say: O my Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from the evil suggestions of the Shaitans;

verses.arabic: وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ رَبِّ اَنْ يَّحْضُرُوْنِ‏(98)
verses.translation: (98) And I seek refuge in Thee! O my Lord! from their presence.

verses.arabic: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءَ اَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُوْنِۙ‏(99)
verses.translation: (99) Until when death overtakes one of them, he says: Send me back, my Lord, send me back;

verses.arabic: لَعَلِّىْۤ اَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيْمَا تَرَكْتُ‌ؕ كَلَّا‌ ؕ اِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا‌ؕ وَمِنْ وَّرَآئِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ اِلٰى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُوْنَ‏(100)
verses.translation: (100) Haply I may do good in that which I have left. By no means! it is a (mere) word that he speaks; and before them is a barrier until the day they are raised.

verses.arabic: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِى الصُّوْرِ فَلَاۤ اَنْسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَّلَا يَتَسَآءَلُوْنَ‏(101)
verses.translation: (101) So when the trumpet is blown, there shall be no ties of relationship between them on that day, nor shall they ask of each other.

verses.arabic: فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِيْنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ‏(102)
verses.translation: (102) Then as for him whose good deeds are preponderant, these are the successful.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِيْنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ خَسِرُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فِىْ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوْنَ‌ ۚ‏(103)
verses.translation: (103) And as for him whose good deeds are light, these are they who shall have lost their souls, abiding in hell

verses.arabic: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوْهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيْهَا كٰلِحُوْنَ‏(104)
verses.translation: (104) The fire shall scorch their faces, and they therein shall be in severe affliction.

verses.arabic: اَلَمْ تَكُنْ اٰيٰتِىْ تُتْلٰى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوْنَ‏(105)
verses.translation: (105) Were not My communications recited to you? But you used to reject them.

verses.arabic: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّيْنَ‏(106)
verses.translation: (106) They shall say: O our Lord! our adversity overcame us and we were an erring people:

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَاِنْ عُدْنَا فَاِنَّا ظٰلِمُوْنَ‏(107)
verses.translation: (107) O our Lord! Take us out of it; then if we return (to evil) surely we shall be unjust.

verses.arabic: قَالَ اخْسَئُوْا فِيْهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُوْنِ‏(108)
verses.translation: (108) He shall say: Go away into it and speak not to Me;

verses.arabic: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِىْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ‌‌ۖ‌ۚ‏(109)
verses.translation: (109) Surely there was a party of My servants who said: O our Lord! we believe, so do Thou forgive us and have mercy on us, and Thou art the best of the Merciful ones.

verses.arabic: فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوْهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتّٰٓى اَنْسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِىْ وَكُنْتُمْ مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُوْنَ‏(110)
verses.translation: (110) But you took them for a mockery until they made you forget My remembrance and you used to laugh at them.

verses.arabic: اِنِّىْ جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا ۙ اَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَآئِزُوْنَ‏(111)
verses.translation: (111) Surely I have rewarded them this day because they were patient, that they are the achievers.

verses.arabic: قٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِيْنَ‏(112)
verses.translation: (112) He will say: How many years did you tarry in the earth?

verses.arabic: قَالُوْا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا اَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْئَلِ الْعَآدِّيْنَ‏(113)
verses.translation: (113) They will say: We tarried a day or part of a day, but ask those who keep account.

verses.arabic: قٰلَ اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا لَّوْ اَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(114)
verses.translation: (114) He will say: You did tarry but a little-- had you but known (it):

verses.arabic: اَفَحَسِبْتُمْ اَنَّمَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَّاَنَّكُمْ اِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُوْنَ‏(115)
verses.translation: (115) What! did you then think that We had created you in vain and that you shall not be returned to Us?

verses.arabic: فَتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ‌ ۚ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ‌ۚ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيْمِ‏(116)
verses.translation: (116) So exalted be Allah, the True King; no god is there but He, the Lord of the honorable dominion.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ يَّدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۙ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهٗ بِهٖۙ فَاِنَّمَا حِسَابُهٗ عِنْدَ رَبِّهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ‏(117)
verses.translation: (117) And whoever invokes with Allah another god-- he has no proof of this-- his reckoning is only with his Lord; surely the unbelievers shall not be successful.

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ‏(118)
verses.translation: (118) And say: O my Lord! forgive and have mercy, and Thou art the best of the Merciful ones.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
سُوْرَةٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهَا وَفَرَضْنٰهَا وَاَنْزَلْنَا فِيْهَاۤ اٰيٰتٍۭ بَيِّنٰتٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ‏(1)
verses.translation: (1) (This is) a chapter which We have revealed and made obligatory and in which We have revealed clear communications that you may be mindful.

verses.arabic: اَلزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِىْ فَاجْلِدُوْا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ‌وَّلَا تَاْخُذْكُمْ بِهِمَا رَاْفَةٌ فِىْ دِيْنِ اللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ‌ۚ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ‏(2)
verses.translation: (2) (As for) the fornicatress and the fornicator, flog each of them, (giving) a hundred stripes, and let not pity for them detain you in the matter of obedience to Allah, if you believe in Allah and the last day, and let a party of believers witness their chastisement.

verses.arabic: اَلزَّانِىْ لَا يَنْكِحُ اِلَّا زَانِيَةً اَوْ مُشْرِكَةً  وَّ الزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنْكِحُهَاۤ اِلَّا زَانٍ اَوْ مُشْرِكٌ‌ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذٰ لِكَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ‏(3)
verses.translation: (3) The fornicator shall not marry any but a fornicatress or idolatress, and (as for) the fornicatress, none shall marry her but a fornicator or an idolater; and it is forbidden to the believers.

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَرْمُوْنَ الْمُحْصَنٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَاْتُوْا بِاَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَاجْلِدُوْهُمْ ثَمٰنِيْنَ جَلْدَةً وَّلَا تَقْبَلُوْا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةً اَبَدًا‌ ۚ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفٰسِقُوْنَ ۙ‏(4)
verses.translation: (4) And those who accuse free women then do not bring four witnesses, flog them, (giving) eighty stripes, and do not admit any evidence from them ever; and these it is that are the transgressors,

verses.arabic: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ تَابُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ وَاَصْلَحُوْا‌ۚ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ‏(5)
verses.translation: (5) Except those who repent after this and act aright, for surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَرْمُوْنَ اَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ اِلَّاۤ اَنْفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَادَةُ اَحَدِهِمْ اَرْبَعُ شَهٰدٰتٍۭ بِاللّٰهِ‌ۙ اِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ‏(6)
verses.translation: (6) And (as for) those who accuse their wives and have no witnesses except themselves, the evidence of one of these (should be taken) four times, bearing Allah to witness that he is most surely of the truthful ones.

verses.arabic: وَالْخَامِسَةُ اَنَّ لَعْنَتَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهِ اِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِيْنَ‏(7)
verses.translation: (7) And the fifth (time) that the curse of Allah be on him if he is one of the liars.

verses.arabic: وَيَدْرَؤُا عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ اَنْ تَشْهَدَ اَرْبَعَ شَهٰدٰتٍۢ بِاللّٰهِ‌ۙ اِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِيْنَۙ‏(8)
verses.translation: (8) And it shall avert the chastisement from her if she testify four times, bearing Allah to witness that he is most surely one of the liars;

verses.arabic: وَالْخَامِسَةَ اَنَّ غَضَبَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهَاۤ اِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ‏(9)
verses.translation: (9) And the fifth (time) that the wrath of Allah be on her if he is one of the truthful.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهٗ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيْمٌ‏(10)
verses.translation: (10) And were it not for Allah's grace upon you and His mercy-- and that Allah is Oft-returning (to mercy), Wise!

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ جَآءُوْ بِالْاِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِّنْكُمْ‌ ؕ لَا تَحْسَبُوْهُ شَرًّا لَّكُمْ‌ ؕ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ‌ ؕ لِكُلِّ امْرِىٴٍ مِّنْهُمْ مَّا اكْتَسَبَ مِنَ الْاِثْمِ‌ ۚ وَالَّذِىْ تَوَلّٰى كِبْرَهٗ مِنْهُمْ لَهٗ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ‏(11)
verses.translation: (11) Surely they who concocted the lie are a party from among you. Do not regard it an evil to you; nay, it is good for you. Every man of them shall have what he has earned of sin; and (as for) him who took upon himself the main part thereof, he shall have a grievous chastisement.

verses.arabic: لَوْلَاۤ اِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوْهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتُ بِاَنْفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًاۙ وَّقَالُوْا هٰذَاۤ اِفْكٌ مُّبِيْنٌ‏(12)
verses.translation: (12) Why did not the believing men and the believing women, when you heard it, think well of their own people, and say: This is an evident falsehood?

verses.arabic: لَوْلَا جَآءُوْ عَلَيْهِ بِاَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ‌ ۚ فَاِذْ لَمْ يَاْتُوْا بِالشُّهَدَآءِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ هُمُ الْكٰذِبُوْنَ‏(13)
verses.translation: (13) Why did they not bring four witnesses of it? But as they have not brought witnesses they are liars before Allah.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهٗ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِىْ مَاۤ اَفَضْتُمْ فِيْهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ‌ ۖ‌ ۚ‏(14)
verses.translation: (14) And were it not for Allah's grace upon you and His mercy in this world and the hereafter, a grievous chastisement would certainly have touched you on account of the discourse which you entered into.

verses.arabic: اِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهٗ بِاَ لْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُوْلُوْنَ بِاَ فْوَاهِكُمْ مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ وَّتَحْسَبُوْنَهٗ هَيِّنًا ‌ ۖ  وَّهُوَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ عَظِيْمٌ‏(15)
verses.translation: (15) When you received it with your tongues and spoke with your mouths what you had no knowledge of, and you deemed it an easy matter while with Allah it was grievous.

verses.arabic: وَ لَوْلَاۤ اِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوْهُ قُلْتُمْ مَّا يَكُوْنُ لَنَاۤ اَنْ نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهٰذَ ا ‌ۖ  سُبْحٰنَكَ هٰذَا بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيْمٌ‏(16)
verses.translation: (16) And why did you not, when you heard it, say: It does not beseem us that we should talk of it; glory be to Thee! this is a great calumny?

verses.arabic: يَعِظُكُمُ اللّٰهُ اَنْ تَعُوْدُوْا لِمِثْلِهٖۤ اَبَدًا اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ‌ۚ‏(17)
verses.translation: (17) Allah admonishes you that you should not return to the like of it ever again if you are believers.

verses.arabic: وَيُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمُ الْاٰيٰتِ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ حَكِيْمٌ‏(18)
verses.translation: (18) And Allah makes clear to you the communications; and Allah is Knowing, Wise.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يُحِبُّوْنَ اَنْ تَشِيْعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ فِى الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌۙ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ وَاَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(19)
verses.translation: (19) Surely (as for) those who love that scandal should circulate respecting those who believe, they shall have a grievous chastisement in this world and the hereafter; and Allah knows, while you do not know.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهٗ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ رَءُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ‏(20)
verses.translation: (20) And were it not for Allah's grace on you and His mercy, and that Allah is Compassionate, Merciful.

verses.arabic: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَتَّبِعُوْا خُطُوٰتِ الشَّيْطٰنِ‌ ؕ وَمَنْ يَّتَّبِعْ خُطُوٰتِ الشَّيْطٰنِ فَاِنَّهٗ يَاْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَآءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ‌ ؕ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهٗ مَا زَكٰى مِنْكُمْ مِّنْ اَحَدٍ اَبَدًا وَّلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُزَكِّىْ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ‌ ؕ وَاللّٰهُ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ‏(21)
verses.translation: (21) O you who believe! do not follow the footsteps of the Shaitan, and whoever follows the footsteps of the Shaitan, then surely he bids the doing of indecency and evil; and were it not for Allah's grace upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have ever been pure, but Allah purifies whom He pleases; and Allah is Hearing, Knowing.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَاْتَلِ اُولُوا الْفَضْلِ مِنْكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ اَنْ يُّؤْتُوْۤا اُولِى الْقُرْبٰى وَالْمَسٰكِيْنَ وَالْمُهٰجِرِيْنَ فِىْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ‌‌ۖ  وَلْيَعْفُوْا وَلْيَصْفَحُوْا‌ ؕ اَلَا تُحِبُّوْنَ اَنْ يَّغْفِرَ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ‌ ؕ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ‏(22)
verses.translation: (22) And let not those of you who possess grace and abundance swear against giving to the near of kin and the poor and those who have fled in Allah's way, and they should pardon and turn away. Do you not love that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَرْمُوْنَ الْمُحْصَنٰتِ الْغٰفِلٰتِ الْمُؤْمِنٰتِ لُعِنُوْا فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌۙ‏(23)
verses.translation: (23) Surely those who accuse chaste believing women, unaware (of the evil), are cursed in this world and the hereafter, and they shall have a grievous chastisement.

verses.arabic: يَّوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ اَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَاَيْدِيْهِمْ وَاَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(24)
verses.translation: (24) On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet shall bear witness against them as to what they did.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يُّوَفِّيْهِمُ اللّٰهُ دِيْنَهُمُ الْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُوْنَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِيْنُ‏(25)
verses.translation: (25) On that day Allah will pay back to them in full their just reward, and they shall know that Allah is the evident Truth.

verses.arabic: اَلْخَبِيْثٰتُ لِلْخَبِيْثِيْنَ وَالْخَبِيْثُوْنَ لِلْخَبِيْثٰتِ‌ۚ وَالطَّيِّبٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِيْنَ وَالطَّيِّبُوْنَ لِلطَّيِّبٰتِ‌ۚ اُولٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُوْنَ مِمَّا يَقُوْلُوْنَ‌ؕ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّرِزْقٌ كَرِيْمٌ‏(26)
verses.translation: (26) Unclean things are for unclean ones and unclean ones are for unclean things, and the good things are for good ones and the good ones are for good things; these are free from what they say; they shall have forgiveness and an honorable sustenance.

verses.arabic: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَدْخُلُوْا بُيُوْتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوْتِكُمْ حَتّٰى تَسْتَاْنِسُوْا وَتُسَلِّمُوْا عَلٰٓى اَهْلِهَا ‌ؕ ذٰ لِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ‏(27)
verses.translation: (27) O you who believe! Do not enter houses other than your own houses until you have asked permission and saluted their inmates; this is better for you, that you may be mindful.

verses.arabic: فَاِنْ لَّمْ تَجِدُوْا فِيْهَاۤ اَحَدًا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوْهَا حَتّٰى يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ‌ۚ وَاِنْ قِيْلَ لَكُمُ ارْجِعُوْا فَارْجِعُوْا‌ۚ هُوَ اَزْكٰى لَكُمْ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ عَلِيْمٌ‏(28)
verses.translation: (28) But if you do not find any one therein, then do not enter them until permission is given to you; and if it is said to you: Go back, then go back; this is purer for you; and Allah is Cognizant of what you do.

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ اَنْ تَدْخُلُوْا بُيُوْتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُوْنَةٍ فِيْهَا مَتَاعٌ لَّكُمْ‌ ؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُوْنَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُوْنَ‏(29)
verses.translation: (29) It is no sin in you that you enter uninhabited houses wherein you have your necessaries; and Allah knows what you do openly and what you hide.

verses.arabic: قُلْ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ يَغُضُّوْا مِنْ اَبْصَارِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوْا فُرُوْجَهُمْ‌ ؕ ذٰ لِكَ اَزْكٰى لَهُمْ‌ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ خَبِيْرٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُوْنَ‏(30)
verses.translation: (30) Say to the believing men that they cast down their looks and guard their private parts; that is purer for them; surely Allah is Aware of what they do.

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ لِّلْمُؤْمِنٰتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ اَبْصَارِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوْجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِيْنَ زِيْنَتَهُنَّ اِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا‌ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلٰى جُيُوْبِهِنَّ‌ وَلَا يُبْدِيْنَ زِيْنَتَهُنَّ اِلَّا لِبُعُوْلَتِهِنَّ اَوْ اٰبَآئِهِنَّ اَوْ اٰبَآءِ بُعُوْلَتِهِنَّ اَوْ اَبْنَآئِهِنَّ اَوْ اَبْنَآءِ بُعُوْلَتِهِنَّ اَوْ اِخْوَانِهِنَّ اَوْ بَنِىْۤ اِخْوَانِهِنَّ اَوْ بَنِىْۤ اَخَوٰتِهِنَّ اَوْ نِسَآئِهِنَّ اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُهُنَّ اَوِ التّٰبِعِيْنَ غَيْرِ اُولِى الْاِرْبَةِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ اَوِ الطِّفْلِ الَّذِيْنَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوْا عَلٰى عَوْرٰتِ النِّسَآءِ‌ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِاَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِيْنَ مِنْ زِيْنَتِهِنَّ‌ ؕ وَتُوْبُوْۤا اِلَى اللّٰهِ جَمِيْعًا اَيُّهَ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ‏(31)
verses.translation: (31) And say to the believing women that they cast down their looks and guard their private parts and do not display their ornaments except what appears thereof, and let them wear their head-coverings over their bosoms, and not display their ornaments except to their husbands or their fathers, or the fathers of their husbands, or their sons, or the sons of their husbands, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or their sisters' sons, or their women, or those whom their right hands possess, or the male servants not having need (of women), or the children who have not attained knowledge of what is hidden of women; and let them not strike their feet so that what they hide of their ornaments may be known; and turn to Allah all of you, O believers! so that you may be successful.

verses.arabic: وَاَنْكِحُوا الْاَيَامٰى مِنْكُمْ وَالصّٰلِحِيْنَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَاِمَآئِكُمْ‌ ؕ اِنْ يَّكُوْنُوْا فُقَرَآءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اللّٰهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ‌ ؕ وَاللّٰهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيْمٌ‏(32)
verses.translation: (32) And marry those among you who are single and those who are fit among your male slaves and your female slaves; if they are needy, Allah will make them free from want out of His grace; and Allah is Ample-giving, Knowing.

verses.arabic: وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَجِدُوْنَ نِكَاحًا حَتّٰى يُغْنِيَهُمُ اللّٰهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ‌ؕ وَالَّذِيْنَ يَبْتَغُوْنَ الْكِتٰبَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوْهُمْ اِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيْهِمْ خَيْرًا ‌‌ۖ  وَّاٰ تُوْهُمْ مِّنْ مَّالِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِىْۤ اٰتٰٮكُمْ ‌ؕ وَلَا تُكْرِهُوْا فَتَيٰتِكُمْ عَلَى الْبِغَآءِ اِنْ اَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِّتَبْتَغُوْا عَرَضَ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا‌ ؕ وَمَنْ يُّكْرِهْهُّنَّ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اِكْرَاهِهِنَّ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ‏(33)
verses.translation: (33) And let those who do not find the means to marry keep chaste until Allah makes them free from want out of His grace. And (as for) those who ask for a writing from among those whom your right hands possess, give them the writing if you know any good in them, and give them of the wealth of Allah which He has given you; and do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, when they desire to keep chaste, in order to seek the frail good of this world's life; and whoever compels them, then surely after their compulsion Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اَنْزَلْنَاۤ اِلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتٍ مُّبَيِّنٰتٍ وَّمَثَلًا مِّنَ الَّذِيْنَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنَ‏(34)
verses.translation: (34) And certainly We have sent to you clear communications and a description of those who have passed away before you, and an admonition to those who guard (against evil).

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُ نُوْرُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ ‌ؕ مَثَلُ نُوْرِهٖ كَمِشْكٰوةٍ فِيْهَا مِصْبَاحٌ‌ ؕ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِىْ زُجَاجَةٍ‌ ؕ اَلزُّجَاجَةُ كَاَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّىٌّ يُّوْقَدُ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ مُّبٰرَكَةٍ زَيْتُوْنَةٍ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَّلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ ۙ يَّكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِىْٓءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ‌ ؕ نُوْرٌ عَلٰى نُوْرٍ‌ ؕ يَهْدِى اللّٰهُ لِنُوْرِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ‌ ؕ وَ يَضْرِبُ اللّٰهُ الْاَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ ۙ‏(35)
verses.translation: (35) Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth; a likeness of His light is as a niche in which is a lamp, the lamp is in a glass, (and) the glass is as it were a brightly shining star, lit from a blessed olive-tree, neither eastern nor western, the oil whereof almost gives light though fire touch it not-- light upon light-- Allah guides to His light whom He pleases, and Allah sets forth parables for men, and Allah is Cognizant of all things.

verses.arabic: فِىْ بُيُوْتٍ اَذِنَ اللّٰهُ اَنْ تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيْهَا اسْمُهٗۙ يُسَبِّحُ لَهٗ فِيْهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْاٰصَالِۙ‏(36)
verses.translation: (36) In houses which Allah has permitted to be exalted and that His name may be remembered in them; there glorify Him therein in the mornings and the evenings,

verses.arabic: رِجَالٌ ۙ لَّا تُلْهِيْهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَّلَا بَيْعٌ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللّٰهِ وَاِقَامِ الصَّلٰوةِ وَ اِيْتَآءِ الزَّكٰوةِ‌ ۙ يَخَافُوْنَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيْهِ الْقُلُوْبُ وَالْاَبْصَارُ ۙ‏(37)
verses.translation: (37) Men whom neither merchandise nor selling diverts from the remembrance of Allah and the keeping up of prayer and the giving of poor-rate; they fear a day in which the hearts and eyes shall turn about;

verses.arabic: لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ اللّٰهُ اَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوْا وَيَزِيْدَهُمْ مِّنْ فَضْلِهٖ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ‏(38)
verses.translation: (38) That Allah may give them the best reward of what they have done, and give them more out of His grace; and Allah gives sustenance to whom He pleases without measure.

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اَعْمَالُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍۢ بِقِيْعَةٍ يَّحْسَبُهُ الظَّمْاٰنُ مَآءً ؕ حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَآءَهٗ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْئًا وَّ وَجَدَ اللّٰهَ عِنْدَهٗ فَوَفّٰٮهُ حِسَابَهٗ‌ ؕ وَاللّٰهُ سَرِيْعُ الْحِسَابِ ۙ‏(39)
verses.translation: (39) And (as for) those who disbelieve, their deeds are like the mirage in a desert, which the thirsty man deems to be water; until when he comes to it he finds it to be naught, and there he finds Allah, so He pays back to him his reckoning in full; and Allah is quick in reckoning;

verses.arabic: اَوْ كَظُلُمٰتٍ فِىْ بَحْرٍ لُّجِّىٍّ يَّغْشٰٮهُ مَوْجٌ مِّنْ فَوْقِهٖ مَوْجٌ مِّنْ فَوْقِهٖ سَحَابٌ‌ؕ ظُلُمٰتٌۢ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍؕ اِذَاۤ اَخْرَجَ يَدَهٗ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرٰٮهَا‌ؕ وَمَنْ لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ اللّٰهُ لَهٗ نُوْرًا فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ نُّوْرٍ‏(40)
verses.translation: (40) Or like utter darkness in the deep sea: there covers it a wave above which is another wave, above which is a cloud, (layers of) utter darkness one above another; when he holds out his hand, he is almost unable to see it; and to whomsoever Allah does not give light, he has no light.

verses.arabic: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهٗ مَنْ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَالطَّيْرُ صٰٓفّٰتٍ‌ؕ كُلٌّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهٗ وَتَسْبِيْحَهٗ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُوْنَ‏(41)
verses.translation: (41) Do you not see that Allah is He Whom do glorify all those who are in the heavens and the earth, and the (very) birds withexpanded wings? He knows the prayer of each one and its glorification, and Allah is Cognizant of what they do.

verses.arabic: وَلِلّٰهِ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ‌ۚ وَاِلَى اللّٰهِ الْمَصِيْرُ‏(42)
verses.translation: (42) And Allah's is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the eventual coming.

verses.arabic: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يُزْجِىْ سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهٗ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهٗ رُكَامًا فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلٰلِهٖ‌ۚ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مِنْ جِبَالٍ فِيْهَا مِنْۢ بَرَدٍ فَيُصِيْبُ بِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ وَ يَصْرِفُهٗ عَنْ مَّنْ يَّشَآءُ‌ ؕ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهٖ يَذْهَبُ بِالْاَبْصَارِؕ‏(43)
verses.translation: (43) Do you not see that Allah drives along the clouds, then gathers them together, then piles them up, so that you see the rain coming forth from their midst? And He sends down of the clouds that are (like) mountains wherein is hail, afflicting therewith whom He pleases and turning it away from whom He pleases; the flash of His lightning almost takes away the sight.

verses.arabic: يُقَلِّبُ اللّٰهُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ‌ ؕ اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰ لِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّاُولِى الْاَبْصَارِ‏(44)
verses.translation: (44) Allah turns over the night and the day; most surely there is a lesson in this for those who have sight.

verses.arabic: وَاللّٰهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍ مِّنْ مَّآءٍ ‌ۚفَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ يَّمْشِىْ عَلٰى بَطْنِهٖ‌ۚ وَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ يَّمْشِىْ عَلٰى رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ يَّمْشِىْ عَلٰٓى اَرْبَعٍ‌ؕ يَخْلُقُ اللّٰهُ مَا يَشَآءُ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ‏(45)
verses.translation: (45) And Allah has created from water every living creature: so of them is that which walks upon its belly, and of them is that which walks upon two feet, and of them is that which walks upon four; Allah creates what He pleases; surely Allah has power over all things.

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ اَنْزَلْنَاۤ اٰيٰتٍ مُّبَيِّنٰتٍ‌ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ يَهْدِىْ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ‏(46)
verses.translation: (46) Certainly We have revealed clear communications, and Allah guides whom He pleases to the right way.

verses.arabic: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَبِالرَّسُوْلِ وَاَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلّٰى فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ‌ؕ وَمَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ‏(47)
verses.translation: (47) And they say: We believe in Allah and in the apostle and we obey; then a party of them turn back after this, and these are not believers.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا دُعُوْۤا اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَرَسُوْلِهٖ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ اِذَا فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْهُمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ‏(48)
verses.translation: (48) And when they are called to Allah and His Apostle that he may judge between them, lo! a party of them turn aside.

verses.arabic: وَاِنْ يَّكُنْ لَّهُمُ الْحَقُّ يَاْتُوْۤا اِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِيْنَؕ‏(49)
verses.translation: (49) And if the truth be on their side, they come to him quickly, obedient.

verses.arabic: اَفِىْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ اَمِ ارْتَابُوْۤا اَمْ يَخَافُوْنَ اَنْ يَّحِيْفَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ‌ؕ بَلْ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ‏(50)
verses.translation: (50) Is there in their hearts a disease, or are they in doubt, or do they fear that Allah and His Apostle will act wrongfully towards them? Nay! they themselves are the unjust.

verses.arabic: اِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اِذَا دُعُوْۤا اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَرَسُوْلِهٖ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ اَنْ يَّقُوْلُوْا سَمِعْنَا وَاَطَعْنَا‌ؕ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ‏(51)
verses.translation: (51) The response of the believers, when they are invited to Allah and His Apostle that he may judge between them, is only to say: We hear and we obey; and these it is that are the successful.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ يُّطِعِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ وَيَخْشَ اللّٰهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفَآئِزُوْنَ‏(52)
verses.translation: (52) And he who obeys Allah and His Apostle, and fears Allah, and is careful of (his duty to) Him, these it is that are the achievers.

verses.arabic: وَاَقْسَمُوْا بِاللّٰهِ جَهْدَ اَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ اَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ‌ ۚ قُلْ لَّا تُقْسِمُوْا‌ ۚ طَاعَةٌ مَّعْرُوْفَةٌ‌  ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ خَبِيْرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(53)
verses.translation: (53) And they swear by Allah with the most energetic of their oaths that if you command them they would certainly go forth. Say: Swear not; reasonable obedience (is desired); surely Allah is aware of what you do.

verses.arabic: قُلْ اَطِيْعُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيْعُوا الرَّسُوْلَ‌ۚ فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُمْ مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ‌ؕ وَاِنْ تُطِيْعُوْهُ تَهْتَدُوْا‌ؕ وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُوْلِ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُ الْمُبِيْنُ‏(54)
verses.translation: (54) Say: Obey Allah and obey the Apostle; but if you turn back, then on him rests that which is imposed on him and on you rests that which is imposed on you; and if you obey him, you are on the right way; and nothing rests on the Apostle but clear delivering (of the message).

verses.arabic: وَعَدَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ كَمَا اسْتَخْلَفَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِيْنَهُمُ الَّذِى ارْتَضٰى لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ اَمْنًا‌ ؕ يَعْبُدُوْنَنِىْ لَا يُشْرِكُوْنَ بِىْ شَيْئًا‌ ؕ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذٰ لِكَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفٰسِقُوْنَ‏(55)
verses.translation: (55) Allah has promised to those of you who believe and do good that He will most certainly make them rulers in the earth as He made rulers those before them, and that He will most certainly establish for them their religion which He has chosen for them, and that He will most certainly, after their fear, give them security in exchange; they shall serve Me, not associating aught with Me; and whoever is ungrateful after this, these it is who are the. transgressors.

verses.arabic: وَاَقِيْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ اٰ تُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَاَطِيْعُوا الرَّسُوْلَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ‏(56)
verses.translation: (56) And keep up prayer and pay the poor-rate and obey the Apostle, so that mercy may be shown to you.

verses.arabic: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مُعْجِزِيْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ‌ۚ وَمَاْوٰٮهُمُ النَّارُ‌ؕ وَلَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيْرُ‏(57)
verses.translation: (57) Think not that those who disbelieve shall escape in the earth, and their abode is the fire; and certainly evil is the resort!

verses.arabic: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لِيَسْتَاْذِنْكُمُ الَّذِيْنَ مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُكُمْ وَالَّذِيْنَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحُلُمَ مِنْكُمْ ثَلٰثَ مَرّٰتٍ‌ؕ مِنْ قَبْلِ صَلٰوةِ الْفَجْرِ وَحِيْنَ تَضَعُوْنَ ثِيَابَكُمْ مِّنَ الظَّهِيْرَةِ وَمِنْۢ بَعْدِ صَلٰوةِ الْعِشَآءِ ‌ؕ  ثَلٰثُ عَوْرٰتٍ لَّكُمْ‌ ؕ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ لَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌۢ بَعْدَهُنَّ‌ ؕ طَوّٰفُوْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ‌ ؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمُ الْاٰيٰتِ‌ ؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ حَكِيْمٌ‏(58)
verses.translation: (58) O you who believe! let those whom your right hands possess and those of you who have not attained to puberty ask permission of you three times; before the morning prayer, and when you put off your clothes at midday in summer, and after the prayer of the nightfall; these are three times of privacy for you; neither is it a sin for you nor for them besides these, some of you must go round about (waiting) upon others; thus does Allah make clear to you the communications, and Allah is Knowing, Wise.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا بَلَغَ الْاَطْفَالُ مِنْكُمُ الْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَاْذِنُوْا كَمَا اسْتَاْذَنَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ‌ؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ اٰيٰتِهٖ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ حَكِيْمٌ‏(59)
verses.translation: (59) And when the children among you have attained to puberty, let them seek permission as those before them sought permission; thus does Allah make clear to you His communications, and Allah is knowing, Wise.

verses.arabic: وَالْقَوَاعِدُ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ الّٰتِىْ لَا يَرْجُوْنَ نِكَاحًا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ اَنْ يَّضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجٰتٍ ۭ بِزِيْنَةٍ‌ ؕ وَاَنْ يَّسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُنَّ‌ ؕ وَاللّٰهُ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ‏(60)
verses.translation: (60) And (as for) women advanced in years who do not hope for a marriage, it is no sin for them if they put off their clothes without displaying their ornaments; and if they restrain themselves it is better for them; and Allah is Hearing, Knowing.

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ عَلَى الْاَعْمٰى حَرَجٌ وَّلَا عَلَى الْاَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَّلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيْضِ حَرَجٌ وَّلَا عَلٰٓى اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَنْ تَاْكُلُوْا مِنْۢ بُيُوْتِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوْتِ اٰبَآئِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوْتِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوْتِ اِخْوَانِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوْتِ اَخَوٰتِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوْتِ اَعْمَامِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوْتِ عَمّٰتِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوْتِ اَخْوَالِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوْتِ خٰلٰتِكُمْ اَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُمْ مَّفَاتِحَهٗۤ اَوْ صَدِيْقِكُمْ‌ؕ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ اَنْ تَاْكُلُوْا جَمِيْعًا اَوْ اَشْتَاتًا‌ ؕ فَاِذَا دَخَلْتُمْ بُيُوْتًا فَسَلِّمُوْا عَلٰٓى اَنْفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةً مِّنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ مُبٰرَكَةً طَيِّبَةً‌  ؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمُ الْاٰيٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ‏(61)
verses.translation: (61) There is no blame on the blind man, nor is there blame on the lame, nor is there blame on the sick, nor on yourselves that you eat from your houses, or your fathers' houses or your mothers' houses, or your brothers' houses, or your sisters' houses, or your paternal uncles' houses, or your paternal aunts' houses, or your maternal uncles' houses, or your maternal aunts' houses, or what you possess the keys of, or your friends' (houses). It is no sin in you that you eat together or separately. So when you enter houses, greet your people with a salutation from Allah, blessed (and) goodly; thus does Allah make clear to you the communications that you may understand.

verses.arabic: اِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللّٰهِ وَرَسُوْلِهٖ وَاِذَا كَانُوْا مَعَهٗ عَلٰٓى اَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوْا حَتّٰى يَسْتَاْذِنُوْهُ‌ ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَسْتَاْذِنُوْنَكَ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَرَسُوْلِهٖ‌ ۚ فَاِذَا اسْتَاْذَنُوْكَ لِبَعْضِ شَاْنِهِمْ فَاْذَنْ لِّمَنْ شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ اللّٰهَ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ‏(62)
verses.translation: (62) Only those are believers who believe in Allah and His Apostle, and when they are with him on a momentous affair they go not away until they have asked his permission; surely they who ask your permission are they who believe in Allah and His Apostle; so when they ask your permission for some affair of theirs, give permission to whom you please of them and ask forgiveness for them from Allah; surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.arabic: لَا تَجْعَلُوْا دُعَآءَ الرَّسُوْلِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَآءِ بَعْضِكُمْ بَعْضًا‌ ؕ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ يَتَسَلَّلُوْنَ مِنْكُمْ لِوَاذًا‌ ۚ فَلْيَحْذَرِ الَّذِيْنَ يُخَالِفُوْنَ عَنْ اَمْرِهٖۤ اَنْ تُصِيْبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ اَوْ يُصِيْبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَ لِيْمٌ‏(63)
verses.translation: (63) Do not hold the Apostle's calling (you) among you to be like your calling one to the other; Allah indeed knows those who steal away from among you, concealing themselves; therefore let those beware who go against his order lest a trial afflict them or there befall them a painful chastisement.

verses.arabic: اَلَاۤ اِنَّ لِلّٰهِ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ ‌ؕ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَاۤ اَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِؕ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُوْنَ اِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْا ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ‏(64)
verses.translation: (64) Now surely Allah's is whatever is in the heavens and the earth; He knows indeed that to which you are conforming yourselves; and on the day on which they are returned to Him He will inform them of what they did; and Allah is Cognizant of all things.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِىْ نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلٰى عَبْدِهٖ لِيَكُوْنَ لِلْعٰلَمِيْنَ نَذِيْرَا ۙ‏(1)
verses.translation: (1) Blessed is He Who sent down the Furqan upon His servant that he may be a warner to the nations;

verses.arabic: ۟الَّذِىْ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَّلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهٗ شَرِيْكٌ فِى الْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهٗ تَقْدِيْرًا‏(2)
verses.translation: (2) He, Whose is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Who did not take to Himself a son, and Who has no associate in the kingdom, and Who created everything, then ordained for it a measure.

verses.arabic: وَاتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُوْنَ شَيْئًا وَّهُمْ يُخْلَقُوْنَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ لِاَنْفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَّلَا نَفْعًا وَّلَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ مَوْتًا وَّلَا حَيٰوةً وَّلَا نُشُوْرًا‏(3)
verses.translation: (3) And they have taken besides Him gods, who do not create anything while they are themselves created, and they control not for themselves any harm or profit, and they control not death nor life, nor raising (the dead) to life.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اِفْكٌ ۟افْتَرٰٮهُ وَاَعَانَهٗ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ اٰخَرُوْنَ‌‌ ۛۚ فَقَدْ جَآءُوْ ظُلْمًا وَّزُوْرًا ۛۚ‏(4)
verses.translation: (4) And those who disbelieve say: This is nothing but a lie which he has forged, and other people have helped him at it; so indeed they have done injustice and (uttered) a falsehood.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوْۤا اَسَاطِيْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلٰى عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَّاَصِيْلًا‏(5)
verses.translation: (5) And they say: The stories of the ancients-- he has got them written-- so these are read out to him morning and evening.

verses.arabic: قُلْ اَنْزَلَهُ الَّذِىْ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا‏(6)
verses.translation: (6) Say: He has revealed it Who knows the secret in the heavens and the earth; surely He is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوْا مَالِ هٰذَا الرَّسُوْلِ يَاْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِىْ فِى الْاَسْوَاقِ‌ ؕ لَوْلَاۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُوْنَ مَعَهٗ نَذِيْرًا ۙ‏(7)
verses.translation: (7) And they say: What is the matter with this Apostle that he eats food and goes about in the markets; why has not an angel been sent down to him, so that he should have been a warner with him?

verses.arabic: اَوْ يُلْقٰٓى اِلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ اَوْ تَكُوْنُ لَهٗ جَنَّةٌ يَّاْكُلُ مِنْهَا‌ ؕ وَقَالَ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ اِنْ تَتَّبِعُوْنَ اِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُوْرًا‏(8)
verses.translation: (8) Or (why is not) a treasure sent down to him, or he is made to have a garden from which he should eat? And the unjust say: You do not follow any but a man deprived of reason.

verses.arabic: اُنْظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوْا لَكَ الْاَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوْا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ سَبِيْلاً‏(9)
verses.translation: (9) See what likenesses do they apply to you, so they have gone astray, therefore they shall not be able to find a way.

verses.arabic: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِىْۤ اِنْ شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّنْ ذٰ لِكَ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِىْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ ۙ وَيَجْعَلْ لَّكَ قُصُوْرًا‏(10)
verses.translation: (10) Blessed is He Who, if He please, will give you what is better than this, gardens beneath which rivers flow, and He will give you palaces.

verses.arabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْا بِالسَّاعَةِ‌ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لِمَنْ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيْرًا‌ ۚ‏(11)
verses.translation: (11) But they reject the hour, and We have prepared a burning fire for him who rejects the hour.

verses.arabic: اِذَا رَاَتْهُمْ مِّنْ مَّكَانٍۢ بَعِيْدٍ سَمِعُوْا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَّزَفِيْرًا‏(12)
verses.translation: (12) When it shall come into their sight from a distant place, they shall hear its vehement raging and roaring.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَاۤ اُلْقُوْا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِيْنَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُوْرًا ؕ‏(13)
verses.translation: (13) And when they are cast into a narrow place in it, bound, they shall there call out for destruction.

verses.arabic: لَا تَدْعُوا الْيَوْمَ ثُبُوْرًا وَّاحِدًا وَّادْعُوْا ثُبُوْرًا كَثِيْرًا‏(14)
verses.translation: (14) Call not this day for one destruction, but call for destructions many.

verses.arabic: قُلْ اَذٰ لِكَ خَيْرٌ اَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِىْ وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُوْنَ ‌ؕ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَّمَصِيْرًا‏(15)
verses.translation: (15) Say: Is this better or the abiding garden which those who guard (against evil) are promised? That shall be a reward and a resort for them.

verses.arabic: لَّهُمْ فِيْهَا مَا يَشَآءُوْنَ خٰلِدِيْنَ‌ ؕ كَانَ عَلٰى رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْئُوْلًا‏(16)
verses.translation: (16) They shall have therein what they desire abiding (in it); it is a promise which it is proper to be prayed for from your Lord.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ فَيَقُوْلُ ءَاَنْتُمْ اَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِىْ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ اَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا السَّبِيْلَ ؕ‏(17)
verses.translation: (17) And on the day when He shall gather them, and whatever they served besides Allah, He shall say: Was it you who led astray these My servants, or did they themselves go astray from the path?

verses.arabic: قَالُوْا سُبْحٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنْۢبَغِىْ لَنَاۤ اَنْ نَّتَّخِذَ مِنْ دُوْنِكَ مِنْ اَوْلِيَآءَ وَ لٰكِنْ مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَاٰبَآءَهُمْ حَتّٰى نَسُوا الذِّكْرَ‌ۚ وَكَانُوْا قَوْمًۢا بُوْرًا‏(18)
verses.translation: (18) They shall say: Glory be to Thee; it was not beseeming for us that we should take any guardians besides Thee, but Thou didst make them and their fathers to enjoy until they forsook the reminder, and they were a people in perdition,

verses.arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْكُمْ بِمَا تَقُوْلُوْنَۙ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ صَرْفًا وَّلَا نَصْرًا‌ۚ وَمَنْ يَّظْلِمْ مِّنْكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيْرًا‏(19)
verses.translation: (19) So they shall indeed give you the lie in what you say, then you shall not be able to ward off or help, and whoever among you is unjust, We will make him taste a great chastisement.

verses.arabic: وَمَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ اِلَّاۤ اِنَّهُمْ لَيَاْكُلُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُوْنَ فِى الْاَسْوَاقِ‌ ؕ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً  ؕ اَتَصْبِرُوْنَ‌ۚ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيْرًا‏(20)
verses.translation: (20) And We have not sent before you any apostles but they most surely ate food and went about in the markets; and We have made some of you a trial for others; will you bear patiently? And your Lord is ever Seeing.
